2. My priority ranks show I'm high priority at w (1st) and y (1st)

The key insight is that my ranking doesn't change my "obtainable set", only which obtainable school I get.

Given my priority ranks, I'm likely to be competitive at w and y. Since z is my true top preference, I want to ensure I have the best chance of getting z if possible.

This way, if z is possible for me, I'll get it. If not, I'll get my next best obtainable option.
